# Best portable power stations for camping

For most campers, a 250-500Wh unit is the sweet spot. It covers phones, lights, camera batteries and a CPAP, and it's light enough to carry one-handed ([PowerStationGearLab](https://powerstationgearlab.com/best/best-portable-power-station-for-camping/)). Pick by how much power you need.

## Weekend tent or car camping (about 290Wh)
- **Jackery Explorer 300 Plus** (~$249, 288Wh, 8.3 lb) is PowerStationGearLab's top overall pick. Jackery's own site has replaced it with the Explorer 300 v2, so the Plus is mainly sold through Amazon and other retailers.
- **Anker SOLIX C300** (~$199, 288Wh) has a built-in lantern and a 5-year warranty. Make sure you buy the standard AC-outlet version, not the "C300 DC."
- **EcoFlow River 3 Plus** (~$269-299, 286Wh) has a 600W inverter, double the Jackery's, and can be expanded.
- **Bluetti Elite 30 V2** is TechRadar's budget pick (288Wh, 600W output). It's $289.99, or about $275.50 with code AFF5OFF: [buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2).

Buy links for the Jackery, Anker and EcoFlow units are on the [PowerStationGearLab guide](https://powerstationgearlab.com/best/best-portable-power-station-for-camping/).

## Multi-day trips, fridge or electric cooler (1-2kWh)
- **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2** is OutdoorGearLab's best for off-grid camping. It scored 81 overall, has 2,200W output, weighs 39 lb, and was recently reduced to under $900 on Amazon ([OutdoorGearLab](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station)).
- **Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2** is their best value, on sale for under $530. It's compact but has a noisy fan.
- **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2** is TechRadar's camping pick ([TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/best/portable-power-stations)). PowerStationGearLab lists it at about $799 and recommends it for van life.
- **Bluetti AC180** (~$499, or $474.05 with code): [buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180). The [AC180 plus 200W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit) is $769, or $730.55 with the code. I only have the Dealectric listing for the AC180, so I can't point to a review of it.

## My pick
If you camp for a weekend or less, get the **Anker C300** for the price or the **Jackery 300 Plus** for the lowest weight. If you want a fridge or multi-day power, get the **Jackery 2000 v2**.

## Notes
- The Dealectric links are affiliate links. They open Bluetti's official store at no extra cost to you, and the AFF5OFF code (5% off) is entered at checkout. Prices were last verified on 2026-10-27 and may change.
- Black Friday sales are coming, and TechRadar notes now is a good time to watch prices.
- Check that a unit's AC output covers whatever you plan to run. A coffee maker or heater needs far more than the small units provide.
- Turn off your CPAP humidifier. It can triple the machine's power draw.

If you tell me your budget and what you'll run (CPAP, fridge, laptop), I can narrow this to one pick.
